Name: Pelipper Town - Chores Indoors
Author: neitolan
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Pelipper Town prevents your Pokémon partners from doing chores inside the farmhouse and cellar (they can in the farm buildings from Robin, like the Barn). This mod lets them help indoors in your home too, such as moving finished bars from your furnaces into a transport-enabled mining chest. Perfect if you like keeping some of your machines inside your home. Comes with separate toggles for the farmhouse and the cellar if you use Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Install with Vortex, or unzip into your Mods folder and run the game through SMAPI.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50344]Pelipper Town[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50344][/url][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Recommended[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] (optional, in-game toggles)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54202][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54202]Pelipper Town - Skip Video Intro[/url] (optional, skip the Pelipper Town Pokémon stampede video intro)[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Tested on desktop in Windows 11 with Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.5.2, and Pelipper Town 1.2.6. Doesn’t change any Pelipper Town files; removing this mod returns everything to Pelipper Town’s usual rules. If a future Pelipper Town update changes how chore locations work, SMAPI’s log shows a warning and partners will skip indoor chores as normal; nothing breaks. Not tested on other platforms e.g. mobile, as I do not use this.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50344]Pelipper Town[/url] is an amazing Pokémon mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AlexanderVerde?gameId=1303]AlexanderVerde[/url], allowing the combination of two of my favourite all-time games. I adore having my favourite buddies with me as I explore, and now helping out around the house too. All credit for the Pokémon partners and their chores goes to them.
